task.name: ODE solver: Lorenz
task.description: Write a Python integrate(f, t_span, y0) function that returns the final state of the fixed Lorenz initial-value problem on [0, 2]; scored by -log10(relative terminal error) - 0.5*log10(calls to f) against a SciPy reference solution, with at most 2000000 calls (higher is better).
task.contract: integrate(f, t_span, y0) -> y(t_end) for an initial-value problem y' = f(t, y); the evaluator counts calls to f. Score: -log10(relative error) - 0.5 * log10(evaluations)
